employers.title: Olena Properties
employers.description:
At Olena Real Estate, we specialize in offering a premium selection of luxury properties and investment opportunities across Abu Dhabi. With an unwavering commitment to excellence, we provide personalized real estate services tailored to buyers, sellers, and investors' unique needs. Whether you're looking for a new home, an investment property, or guidance through the real estate market, we deliver trusted expertise and unparalleled insights to help you achieve your goals.

Our Services Include:
Luxury Villas & Apartments
Exclusive Off-Plan Projects
Commercial Real Estate Solutions
Property Investment Advisory

We pride ourselves on our deep understanding of the local market, our network of exclusive properties, and our client-centric approach. Let's make your real estate aspirations a reality.

state.summary: Project Manager with six years of experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives in technology and business operations. Skilled in stakeholder communication, project planning, risk tracking, and delivery governance across complex environments. Known for building practical workflows, improving team alignment, and keeping priorities moving under tight deadlines.

experience.details:
Supported schedules, budgets, and documentation for transformation initiatives.
Facilitated team meetings and maintained cross-department action logs.
Escalated risks before blockers affected delivery timelines.
Prepared progress packs for sponsors and steering groups.

Analyzed workflow data to identify service delivery delays.
Prepared reports supporting resource planning and prioritization.
Documented process improvements for managers and project teams.
Built performance dashboards used in monthly operational reviews.

Supported project timelines, meeting notes, and team follow-ups.
Updated task boards and tracked deadlines for project initiatives.
Maintained project files, decision logs, and change records.
Coordinated action owners to close overdue tasks.

education.details: Focused on operations, organizational strategy, finance, and project delivery.
Completed practical coursework in business planning and process administration.
